name: Boston Bag Hitotsubun no
original_name: ボストンバッグひとつ分の
source:
His life wasn't one of regret, nor would he say as much, but the young man made a summing up, packed his things, and set out on a journey with a single bag. It took an encounter with a gentler soul, to change his own.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE167958.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
他的一生并没有什么遗憾，也不会说太多，但年轻人做了一个总结，收拾好东西，背起行囊踏上了旅途。他需要遇到一个更温柔的灵魂，才能改变自己。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE167958.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
